title: Gully's from the dock
logline: The shack from the dock's end, morning, the door open, nobody at the counter through it, the end stool's leg visible. Gully's flatbed gone. The pup not here either.

panels.composition: The shingle shack from the dock's far end at morning: the open door, and through it the counter's edge and the end stool's leg, nobody in the frame. The lot empty. The corkboard a crowded shape through the door. Fog thinning.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a shingle bait shack seen from the far end of its dock in morning fog with the door open and only the edge of a counter and a stool's leg visible inside, no people, an empty lot, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: Absent. The stool's leg through the door.
